title: One Exchange, Three Counters
label: ch:mw-counter-exchange
canDo: I can run one five-turn counter exchange over the shopping, transport, and food words this book has already taught, changing nothing but the noun.

payoff.summary: Each of the three noun sets is run through the exchange in turn, the five least-drilled signs are retrieved alone, and the whole five-turn exchange then passes separately in listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
